title: Program precondition
statement: Let $A$ be a program with $m$ registers, and let $x$ be an input bit string. A configuration satisfies the precondition when, if its control state is an instruction comparing two registers, those registers are distinct; if it compares a register with the input payload, the input has the prescribed valid plain encoding; if it compares a register with either component of a paired payload, the input has the prescribed valid paired encoding; and if it is a decider call, the list of argument registers has no repetitions. All other configurations satisfy the precondition.
